source: Released TB2J output of Tellez-Mora, He, Bousquet, Wirtz and Romero (2024): SIESTA DFT (PBE; DFT+U where stated), isotropic exchange from the magnetic force theorem (Green-function method) with TB2J 0.7.4.x.

materials.NiO: rock-salt NiO, one Ni per primitive fcc cell in the FM reference
materials.FeCl2: 1T-FeCl2 (bulk, P-3m1 layers in rhombohedral stacking), three Fe layers per hexagonal cell
materials.FePS3: monoclinic FePS3 (C2/m van der Waals layers, Fe honeycomb), four Fe per cell; DFT (U = 0) and DFT+U (U = 3 eV on Fe 3d per the paper) workflows
materials.FeP: orthorhombic FeP (MnP type, Pnma; metallic), four Fe per cell

calculation_notes: Calculation labels are the archive folder names. Each calculation was done in its own cell and magnetic configuration; its TB2J header lines, cell, atoms (positions, Wannier charges and moments) are returned with every exchange purchase from it.
exchange_convention: Archived TB2J convention: E = -sum_{i != j} J_ij e_i.e_j over ordered pairs (each bond appears twice, as (i,j,R) and (j,i,-R)), e_i unit vectors along the local moments, J > 0 ferromagnetic, meV. R is in lattice vectors of the calculation's own cell; vector = r_j + R.cell - r_i in Angstrom; distance is |vector|, as archived.
isotropic_only: Only isotropic exchange is served (the archive README states that only the isotropic constants are valid for NiO, FeCl2 and FePS3).

exchange.returns: all isotropic pairs of that calculation with lo <= archived distance < hi, as rows [i, j, Rx, Ry, Rz, J_iso_meV, dx_A, dy_A, dz_A, distance_A], plus the calculation metadata.
